name: ultimate-vocal-remover
summary: Pull the vocals out of a song, and keep the music too.

permissions.files: Open the song you choose and save the vocals and music next to it.
permissions.library: Add the vocals and the music to your Library.
permissions.data: Keep the separation models it downloads, so each one downloads only once.
permissions.gpu: Use your graphics chip to split songs faster.

network.why: Download the separation model the first time you use it.
